titles.title: Government Audit and Accountability of Federally Funded State-Administered Programs Act
Government Audit and Accountability of Federally Funded State-Administered Programs Act
A bill to require an assessment of program areas and administrative practices presenting the greatest risk to the integrity of Federal funds administered by States and local governments.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

committee.name: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
